user.title: Heating Controller
user.description: Choose how many rooms to display and optionally select an outdoor weather entity (recommended) or a legacy temperature sensor. Its temperature is shown on the thermostat and clock screens.

rooms.title: Heating Controller rooms
rooms.description: Select a climate entity, optional humidity sensor and icon for each enabled room.

error.invalid_count: Choose between two and four rooms.
error.missing_climate: Select a climate entity for every enabled room.
error.duplicate_climates: Each room must use a different climate entity.
error.invalid_icon: Choose one of the supported room icons.

init.title: Heating Controller rooms
init.description: Choose the number of active rooms and optionally select an outdoor weather entity (recommended) or a legacy temperature sensor. Its temperature is shown on the thermostat and clock screens. Settings for disabled rooms are retained.

rooms.title: Configure active rooms
rooms.description: Only the selected number of rooms is shown. Changes are sent to the display automatically; no firmware edit or ESPHome recompile is required.

error.invalid_count: Choose between two and four rooms.
error.missing_climate: Select a climate entity for every enabled room.
error.duplicate_climates: Each room must use a different climate entity.
error.invalid_icon: Choose one of the supported room icons.
